last_3_comments.body:
## Proposal

### Root cause
The Role page keeps the optimistic accountID in the route, but after AddMembersToWorkspace resolves that temporary personal-details entry is replaced. Its direct lookup then returns no login/member, so AccessOrNotFoundWrapper blocks the page. The parent Member Details page already handles this race via the #96449 optimistic-ID fallback.

### Fix
Reuse that fallback in WorkspaceMemberDetailsRolePage, resolve the permanent accountID with usePersonalDetailByLogin, and use the resolved identity for permission checks, isRuleBotEnforcingRules, updateWorkspaceMembersRole,
